notes.title: New Content Update + BIGGEST DISCOUNT EVER Out now!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

The Winter sale just went live right now and I'm happy to announce that not only is the game discounted to a ridiculous $1.19, but I just added a HUGE update to the game that adds tons of content! Below are the patch notes:

P.S. If you like the game, a review would help me out so much :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2491670/Wanted_Shadows/

[list]
[*]  Added a new character, Hourkoo - Attack speed is increased by 2x if health is 1. Every additional health point decreases attack speed by 30%.
[*] Added the bonus level Bomb Factory - has all new enemies and a cool new environment.
[*] Added the bonus level Cold Fire Plains - has all new enemies and a cool new environment.
[*]  Added 8 new enemies that appear in the bonus levels.
[*] Added 16 new achievements for the new character and bonus levels.
[*] Made it such that completing higher ascensions grants you the achievements for the lower ones as well, e.g. completing ascension 6 grants you the achievements for ascensions 1-6.
[*] Fixed bug that made the high tolerance upgrade do the opposite of what it was supposed to do.
[*] Fixed some typos.
[/list]

And that's it! I also just posted a new video on YouTube that goes over one of the level design processes I use in my games, so check that out if it interests you!

[previewyoutube=lQssygrC7vc;full][/previewyoutube]

If you haven't played my other game, Soul Stalker, you can get it at a discount through the bundle below if you already own Wanted Shadows, and that game is also on its biggest discount ever through the Winter Sale! It's in the same genre as Wanted Shadows but with more emphasis on decision making and less important placed on action, so get the game if that sounds like what you'd like!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/36217/Rad_Roguelikes/

- Conrad, Lead Developer

notes.title: HUGE Update Out Now (New Character, 3 New Ascensions, 28 New Achievements)!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Thank you all for the positive reception of Wanted Shadows since its release 4 days ago! I've been working hard on an update since then, and here are the patch notes for it!

Also, [b]I would really appreciate it if you left a review[/b]! It's the best way to support the game!

[h1]Version 1.1.0 Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new character, Holig. Stamina depletes instantly when attacking and dashing, but has incredibly fast daze recovery and more power.
[*] Added ascension 4 - Enemies have even more HP.
[*] Added ascension 5 - Enemies move faster.
[*] Added ascension 6 - Enemies move faster over time.
[*] Added achievements for completing all of ascensions 1 through 6 on Tundra.
[*] Added achievements for completing all of ascensions 1 through 6 on Mansion.
[*] Added achievements for completing all of ascensions 1 through 6 on Hell.
[*] Added achievements for beating Hell in ascension 6 for each character.
[*] Increased the cost of all unlockables.
[*] Fixed bug that would cause the game to crash if you obtained the Spider Shock.
[*] Changed the color of the hammer enemy in Hell from purple to white to make it more easily visible.
[*] Fixed bug that caused the special upgrade and level up screens to appear at the same time.
[*] Fixed bug that caused the Hell miniboss to have no entrance animation.
[*] Fixed bug that caused beams to self-proc crit and hence crash the game.
[*] Fixed bug that caused music to be unhearable if there were too many sound effects playing.
[*] Fixed bug that caused fast-acting hitboxes to not register as hits on enemies.
[*] Toned down sound effects on melee attacks.
[*] Fixed some upgrade typos.
[/list]

That's it for the patch notes, but I wanted to mention that if you own Wanted Shadows, you can get our other game, Soul Stalker, at a discount! Also, if you don't own Wanted Shadows but you do own Soul Stalker, then you can get a discount on Wanted Shadows!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714240/Soul_Stalker/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2491670/Wanted_Shadows/

Anyways, that's it for this update, I hope you all enjoy it, and leave a review if you have since it helps so so much :)

- Conrad, Lead Developer

notes.title: New Patch Out Now! (+YouTube video documenting the game's full development)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

Thank you all so much with the warm reception with the release! I've made a little patch to fix some issues, you can find the patch notes below.

[h1]Version 1.0.3 Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Some players reported crashing on obtaining a certain combination of shock upgrades. While I was unable to replicate the crash, I believe that I found the cause of the issue and have made a change that hopefully fixes it. If it still happens to you, please send a detailed recount of how your run went so that I can try to replicate and fix the issue!
[*] When the game crashed, you would lose the save progress from your current session. This no longer happens as the game saves more often.
[/list]

I'll be making more updates very soon, but this is it for version 1.0.3! If you're enjoying the game, [u][b]I'd really appreciate it if you left a review[/b][/u] as it's the best way to help us! Also, if you want to benefit from the launch discount, get the game as it will end soon! On top of that, you can get a further discount if you own our other game, Soul Stalker. If you own Wanted Shadows, you also get a discount on Soul Stalker!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714240/Soul_Stalker/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2491670/Wanted_Shadows

On top of this, I recently uploaded a video on my YouTube channel about the full development of Wanted Shadows! If that interests you, watch it in the video below!

[previewyoutube=oqwp39I98NA;full][/previewyoutube]

Anyways, that's it for this update, see you all soon :)

- Conrad, Lead Developer
